title: project.annotations request
description: Report a project's reviewed knowledge about one image or one object. Writes nothing. The project is named by the envelope's `project` locator; the scope is an argument, because a project describes several of each. Exactly one of `image` and `object` is named: they are different questions, answered in different address spaces. `read_only`.

image.description: Which of the project's images to resolve against, in hunk space. An offset means nothing until you say which image it is an offset into.

object.description: Which of the project's objects to list annotations for, in file space. A project created by `project.init` has objects and no image at all, so this is the scope that answers for one.
